$comment: Arizona's two local ordinances diverge on exactly the point a payroll system is most likely to get wrong: Flagstaff abolished the tip credit for 2026 while Tucson kept the state's $3.00.

jurisdictions.name: Flagstaff
jurisdictions.coverage: All employers, for work performed in Flagstaff.

tipped.note: FLAGSTAFF ELIMINATED ITS TIP CREDIT effective 2026-01-01: tipped employees must now receive the same $18.35 base wage as everyone else. Arizona's statewide $3.00 tip credit does NOT apply in Flagstaff -- a payroll system inheriting the state rule here underpays by $3.00 an hour.

sources.title: City of Flagstaff -- City of Flagstaff announces minimum wage for 2026
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session from the city's own announcement: $18.35 effective 2026-01-01, and no lower minimum wage for tipped employees from 2026 onward.

jurisdictions.name: Tucson
jurisdictions.coverage: All employers, for work performed in Tucson.

tipped.note: Tucson keeps a $3.00 tip credit, the same figure Arizona allows statewide, applied against the higher city rate.

sources.title: City of Tucson -- Tucson Minimum Wage Act (Proposition 206, November 2021)
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session: $15.45 standard and $12.45 tipped (a $3.00 maximum tip credit) effective 2026-01-01, with annual CPI adjustment under Proposition 206. The city's own page was located but not rendered directly this pass.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Labor Center -- Inventory of US City and County Minimum Wage Ordinances
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session. The standing national census of local minimum wage ordinances -- used here to establish WHICH jurisdictions exist (so none is silently omitted), with each rate then cross-checked against a second source.

provisional.note: Carried forward from the 2026 file on 2026-10-25 so that a 2027-dated query resolves instead of failing. Every figure is 2026's unless listed in updatedFor2027 (each with the state agency's own announcement or the statute). Remove this block only after every figure has been re-read against a 2027 source. LOCAL ORDINANCES ARE NOT YET UPDATED for 2027: many step on 1 January 2027 (e.g. Denver $19.84, Minneapolis $17.02, Seattle, Flagstaff, Albuquerque, Portland ME). The figures here are 2026's until each ordinance is re-read.
